verdict.rationale: Navan documents a built-in AI assistant (Ava/Navan Edge) that analyzes travel/expense spend, summarizes and predicts spend, and books/manages trips with explicit user confirmation, plus 24/7 human backup — this is a native in-product assistant, not an external tool. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the assistant's task-delegation quality and reliability beyond vendor blog/marketing claims.
